about: [C1] Going down through the kit (game.fail): IV The Door and VIII The Block share the Game's fall now (their own retries kept: IV's door already shut, VIII's dead of the beats before); health reaching zero in a scene with neither (the kit's test bed) uses the default. Health is taken by a debug hook (G.health.damage), the rest is the game's. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/kit_downs.json

steps.name: IV The Door: down, back at the shadows

steps.expect: G.health.hp >= 1 && G.health.hp < 5 && G.health.spared >= 1 && G.hud.warnText === 'You’re hit. Get to cover.' && !G.failing
steps.label: [C1] the hit that would take the last before any warning is spared: one left, the warning up
IV: down is the kit's fall (lane C5: the gun kit's - its reason, here a hit from nowhere: 'Shot.'), back to the shadows (warned a second and more before)

steps.expect: performance.now() - window.__t0 < 10000 && G.scenes.current.id === 'gunfight' && G.scenes.beat === 'shadows' && G.health.hp === 100 && !G.controller.frozen && G.controller.mode === 'gun'
steps.label: IV: up at the shadows with control, under ten seconds
IV: the retry (lane C5): the revolver out and full, the door shut, the men at its glass again

steps.name: [C8] VIII The Block: down in the flank, back at the flank

steps.expect: G.health.hp >= 1 && G.health.hp < 5 && G.health.spared >= 1 && G.hud.warnText === 'You’re hit. Get to cover.' && !G.failing
steps.label: [C1] the hit that would take the last before any warning is spared: one left, the warning up
VIII: down is the kit's fall, back to the flank (warned a second and more before)

steps.expect: performance.now() - window.__t0 < 10000 && G.scenes.beat === 'flank' && G.health.hp === 100 && !G.controller.frozen && G.b7 && G.fails('flank') === 1
steps.label: VIII: up in the flank with control, its mercy counting the down
